lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Aruba and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, GeoPackage, KML). The dataset represents approximately 75% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 1 year 5 months and 1% of features updated within the last 6 months.
